senses.gloss: ग्लपन ग्लपन, i. e. ग्लै, Caus., + अन, n. Relaxation, Suśr. 1, 151, 15.

ग्लह् ग्लह्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To play with dice, MBh. 8, 4404.
 2. To win, 7, 6538.
 3. † = ग्रह् (v. r.).

ग्लह ग्लह् + अ, m.
 1. A gambler, MBh. 2, 2037.
 2. A stake, MBh. 2, 2499; Daśak. in Chr. 188, 22.
 3. A die, MBh. 8, 3756.
 4. A dice-box, MBh. 2, 1986.
 5. Playing with dice, MBh. 5, 1898.
 6. Aim, MBh. 8, 4402.

ग्लानि ग्लानि, i. e. ग्लै + नि, f.
 1. Lassitude, MBh. 1, 8142.
 2. Inertness, Man. 1, 53.
